metadata.description: Short prefix for resource names, e.g. "ndaassist".
Deployment environment.
Azure region. Defaults to the region of the partial prior attempt.
LOG_LEVEL override. Empty => DEBUG in dev, INFO otherwise.
LOG_FORMAT override. Empty => console in dev, json otherwise.
Container image for both apps. Default is a public placeholder for the first infra deploy; CI replaces it with the ACR image.
Port the api listens on (external ingress target).
CPU cores per replica.
Memory per replica.
Key Vault secret references projected as env vars on both apps. Empty in P0; P1+ adds e.g. { envVarName: "DATABASE_URL", secretName: "database-url" }.
Postgres administrator login.
Postgres administrator password. Supplied at deploy time; never committed. In .bicepparam use readEnvironmentVariable().
Postgres compute SKU name.
Postgres compute tier.
Postgres provisioned storage (GB).
ACR SKU.
Azure Files share quota (GB).
Enable Key Vault purge protection (recommended on for prod).
Extra tags merged onto every resource.
Azure region for all resources in this module.
Base name used to derive resource names, e.g. "ndaassist-dev".
Retention in days for the Log Analytics workspace.
Tags applied to every resource.
Resource id of the Log Analytics workspace.
Customer (workspace) id used by the Container Apps environment.
App Insights connection string. Feed to APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING.
Azure region for the identity.
Base name used to derive the identity name, e.g. "ndaassist-dev".
Tags applied to the identity.
Resource id of the user-assigned managed identity.
Principal (object) id — used for role assignments.
Client id — used for AAD-based KV/registry auth from the container.
Azure region for the vault.
Base name used to derive the vault name.
Principal id of the user-assigned identity to grant Secrets User.
Tenant id that owns the vault.
Soft-delete retention window in days.
Enable purge protection. Off in dev to allow clean teardown; on in prod.
Tags applied to the vault.
Resource id of the vault.
Vault name.
Vault data-plane URI, e.g. https://kv-xxx.vault.azure.net/.
Azure region for the registry.
Base name used to derive the registry name.
Principal id of the user-assigned identity to grant AcrPull.
Registry SKU. Basic is sufficient for dev; Standard/Premium for prod.
Tags applied to the registry.
Resource id of the registry.
Registry name.
Login server, e.g. acrxxx.azurecr.io — used as the image prefix.
Azure region for the server.
Base name used to derive the server name.
Administrator login name.
Administrator password. Supplied at deploy time; never committed.
Application database name.
Compute SKU name, e.g. Standard_B1ms (dev burstable) or Standard_D2ds_v5 (prod).
Compute tier for the SKU.
Provisioned storage in GB.
PostgreSQL major version.
Allow other Azure services (e.g. the Container Apps environment) to reach the server. VNet integration is the documented hardening step (AZURE.md).
Tags applied to the server.
Resource id of the flexible server.
Fully-qualified domain name of the server.
Application database name.
Azure region for the storage account.
Base name used to derive the account name.
Name of the Azure Files share.
Share quota in GB.
Redundancy SKU for the account.
Tags applied to the account.
Resource id of the storage account.
Storage account name — feeds the Container Apps environment storage.
Azure Files share name.
Azure region for the environment.
Base name used to derive the environment name.
Log Analytics customer (workspace) id.
Resource id of the Log Analytics workspace (for the shared key lookup).
Storage account name backing the Azure Files share.
Azure Files share name to mount.
Name of the environment storage definition apps reference in their volumes.
Tags applied to the environment.
Resource id of the managed environment.
Default domain of the environment (used to build the api ingress FQDN).
Name of the storage definition apps mount as /data.
Container app name, e.g. nda-api or nda-worker.
Azure region.
Resource id of the Container Apps managed environment.
Resource id of the user-assigned managed identity.
ACR login server used as the image registry (for identity-based pulls).
Container image reference. Defaults to a public placeholder so the first infra deploy succeeds before CI has pushed the real image.
APP_ENV value: dev | prod | test.
LOG_LEVEL value, e.g. DEBUG or INFO.
LOG_FORMAT value: console | json.
App Insights connection string. Empty string => telemetry export disabled (capability off, not an error).
Key Vault data-plane URI, e.g. https://kv-xxx.vault.azure.net/.
Secrets to project from Key Vault as env vars. Each item: { envVarName, secretName }. Empty in P0; P1+ adds e.g. { envVarName: "DATABASE_URL", secretName: "database-url" }.
Name of the environment storage definition to mount at /data.
Mount path for the shared Azure Files volume.
Enable external ingress (api). False for worker.
Ingress target port (the port the app listens on).
Command override. Empty => use the image default (api). Worker passes ["python","-m","app.worker"].
CPU cores per replica.
Memory per replica.
Minimum replicas. 1 keeps both apps always-on.
Maximum replicas.
Tags applied to the app.

variables.ingressConfig: [if(parameters('enableExternalIngress'), createObject('external', true(), 'targetPort', parameters('targetPort'), 'transport', 'auto', 'allowInsecure', false(), 'traffic', createArray(createObject('latestRevision', true(), 'weight', 100))), null())]
